review_findings: The proposed listener fills the deliberately open Provider authentication boundary without changing Scheduler or Provider-result authority.
Exact signed bytes and delivery identity are retained, so replay and crash recovery can be proven rather than inferred.
Session identity comes from the trusted endpoint/process route and remains subject to the Scheduler's exact wait and TaskRun checks.
The HTTP server is a thin event-driven WSGI wrapper around the same one-request transport, not a polling controller.
The plan keeps secrets out of configuration and durable artifacts and denies them to project command profiles.
Product source, Workflow routing, TaskRun completion, Quality, Write Authority, Human Gate, release, production, and merge paths are excluded.

skill_rule_mappings.assessment: root skillctl provider-webhook and WSGI both call one GitHub transport and the existing Scheduler
listener authenticates and normalizes only; Scheduler binds/delivers and Provider adapter interprets conclusions
signature, payload, repository, delivery replay, route, and Scheduler mismatch are rejected
signed provider evidence and transport receipts bind the exact Scheduler event and wake receipt
all ingress code and state stay in Harness control-plane paths
